proposed_defect: SEC-1 expires a session token after 15 minutes without user input, but a full export runs up to 2 hours with no user input and the page authenticates every poll with that token, so the page loses access before the export finishes.

proposed_evidence.quote: A session token expires after 15 minutes without user input
The page polls the job endpoint every 10 seconds and authenticates each poll with the user's session token
A full-project export can run for up to 2 hours

proposed_defect: LOG-1 says logs are kept for 7 days but LOG-2 says logs are kept for 30 days.

proposed_evidence.quote: Projects on the free tier keep logs for 7 days
Projects on the paid tier keep logs for 30 days

proposed_defect: PAY-2 retries a timed-out capture three times following RTY-1, RTY-1 takes the retry budget from TIER-1, and TIER-1 gives capture a budget of 0 because a repeat could charge the customer twice.

proposed_evidence.quote: A capture that times out is retried three times following RTY-1
The number of retries for a call is the retry budget listed for its call type in TIER-1

proposed_defect: WC-9 and decision D4 make outward actions depend on a coordinator quoting the user's instruction in the brief, which no command can check, so nothing in the spec enforces that authorization.

proposed_evidence.quote: It turns on only through the command's own explicit flag written in the brief.
The coordinator quotes the instruction in the brief and passes the command's explicit flag

proposed_defect: SA-7 says every command writes its report under `.dev/worker-reports/<slug>/` whatever its output flag says, but the cleanup-audit row fixes its report at `.claude-audit/pass<N>-summary.md` with a fixed output directory.

proposed_evidence.quote: every command writes its report under `.dev/worker-reports/<slug>/`, whatever its output flag says

proposed_defect: GW-2 limits request bodies to 10 MB, but NGX-1 makes the proxy in front of the gateway reject bodies larger than 10 Mbit (1.25 MB), so bodies the gateway accepts never arrive.

proposed_evidence.quote: Request bodies are limited to 10 MB
The proxy in front of the gateway rejects bodies larger than 10 Mbit

proposed_defect: WC-5 maps a `blocked` report to `worker_done --outcome failed`, but AC-2.2 expects `worker_done --outcome succeeded` for a run whose contract says `status: blocked`.

proposed_evidence.quote: `--outcome failed` when the report says `failed` or `blocked`

proposed_defect: PAY-3 has the worker hold its lock for a 2-second capture (citing LOCK-2), LOCK-2 limits a lock to 5 ticks, and CFG-1 defines a tick as 100 milliseconds, so the lock lasts 500 ms and expires during the capture.

proposed_evidence.quote: A payment capture takes 2 seconds, and the worker holds its lock for the whole capture (LOCK-2)
A lock is held for at most 5 ticks (see CFG-1 for the tick)
